title: Closure properties of integer multiplicity currents (Simon 3.2)
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open and k ∈ ℕ. (a) Every integer multiplicity X ∈ D_k(U) has M_W(X) < ∞ for all W ⊂⊂ U. (b) Every restriction of an integer multiplicity X ∈ D_k(U) to a set A is integer multiplicity. (c) If X, Y ∈ D_k(U) are integer multiplicity, a, b ∈ ℤ and Z(ω) = aX(ω) + bY(ω) for all test forms ω, then Z is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn U k, IsIntegerMultiplicity X → ∀ W, CompactlyContainedOpen W U → X.massOn W < ∞) ∧ (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (A : Set (Eucl P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U k), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsRestriction X A S → IsIntegerMultiplicity S) ∧ (∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (X Y Z : GeometricCurrentOn U k) (a b : ℤ), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U k, Z ω = (a : ℝ) * X ω + (b : ℝ) * Y ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity Z)
